segments.en: Let's take another listen to today's dialogue and we'll be right back.
segments.zh: 让我们再听一次今天的对话，我们会马上回来的。

segments.en: You want to go to the movies tonight?
segments.zh: 你今晚想去看电影吗？

segments.en: Sure.
segments.zh: 当然。

segments.en: What's playing?
segments.zh: 玩什么？

segments.en: The new Twilight movie.
segments.zh: 新的暮光之城电影。

segments.en: Twilight?
segments.zh: 暮光之城？

segments.en: As in the vampire movies?
segments.zh: 和吸血鬼电影一样？

segments.en: No way am I watching that.
segments.zh: 我不可能在看那个。

segments.en: I don't understand why everyone is so excited about these films about vampires.
segments.zh: 我不明白为什么每个人都对这些关于吸血鬼的电影如此兴奋。

segments.en: It doesn't make sense.
segments.zh: 这说不通。

segments.en: Of course it does.
segments.zh: 当然会应验啦。

segments.en: It's like a modern tale of Romeo and Juliet.
segments.zh: 这就像一个罗密欧与朱丽叶的现代故事。

segments.en: You have a couple that is in love, but can't be together because they're so different.
segments.zh: 你有一对相爱但不能在一起的情侣，因为他们是如此不同。

segments.en: Add in the fact that immortality and superhuman strength is really sexy, and there you have it.
segments.zh: 再加上不朽和超人的力量真的很性感，你就有了。

segments.en: Plus, the cast is hip. Young people that make the movie even more enticing.
segments.zh: 另外，演员很时髦。 让这部电影更加诱人的年轻人。

segments.en: I don't buy into that.
segments.zh: 我不买。

segments.en: I think it's just a fad.
segments.zh: 我认为这只是一种时尚。

segments.en: Pretty soon this will pass and everyone will be into werewolves or zombies.
segments.zh: 这阵风潮很快就会过去，到时大家又会迷上狼人或僵尸。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So obviously the dialogue revolves around Twilight and vampires, but mostly it's all about, as we said, something that's hip, that's current, that's popular now, but many times is also a fad.
segments.zh: 所以很明显，对话围绕着暮光之城和吸血鬼展开，但正如我们所说，这一切都是关于时髦、现在的、现在流行的东西，但很多时候也是一种时尚。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So let's think.
segments.zh: 所以让我们想想。

segments.en: What was a fad from the 1980s?
segments.zh: 1980 年代的时尚是什么？

segments.en: I think the 80s, the fad was, maybe you can talk about the hairstyles. Men and women had those big kind of hairstyles.
segments.zh: 我想 80 年代，时尚是，也许你可以谈谈发型。 男人和女人都有那些大发型。

segments.en: Long in the back and very tall in the front.
segments.zh: 在后面很长，前面很高。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So in the 80s, as far as fashion fads, things that were only popular for a short time, we had big hair and we had bright colors like electric pink and green and blue, and also those t-shirts that would change color when it was hot or cold.
segments.zh: 所以在 80 年代，就时尚时尚而言，那些只在短时间内流行的东西，我们有一头大头发，我们有明亮的颜色，比如电粉色、绿色和蓝色，还有那些在炎热或冷的时候会改变颜色的 T 恤。

segments.en: Those were really cool.
segments.zh: 那些真的很酷。

segments.en: Those should come back.
segments.zh: 那些应该回来。

segments.en: Those were super hip.
segments.zh: 那些是超级时髦的。

segments.en: Well, now it's hip to wear 80s clothes.
segments.zh: 好吧，现在穿 80 年代的衣服很时髦。

segments.en: So it's another fad.
segments.zh: 所以这是另一种时尚。

segments.en: Right, exactly. Because then that's called that you're being, you like, what is it?
segments.zh: 没错，没错。 因为那被称为你是，你喜欢，它是什么？

segments.en: Retro.
segments.zh: 复古。

segments.en: Retro, yeah.
segments.zh: 复古，是的。

segments.en: Yeah, retro means you like to use styles from a long time ago. So yeah, 70s style, 80s style.
segments.zh: 是的，复古意味着你喜欢使用很久以前的风格。 所以，是的，70 年代风格，80 年代风格。

segments.en: And well, in the movies now, the fad before was magic and sorcerers. You had Harry Potter.
segments.zh: 好吧，在现在的电影中，以前的时尚是魔法和巫师。 你有哈利波特。

segments.en: Now it's turned to vampires.
segments.zh: 现在它变成了吸血鬼。

segments.en: That's right. I wonder what the fad will be in a couple of years. I don't think, I don't agree with the person in today's dialogue.
segments.zh: 没错。 我想知道几年后的时尚会是什么样子。 我不认为，我不同意今天对话中的人。

segments.en: I don't think zombies will be a fad.
segments.zh: 我不认为僵尸会是一种时尚。

segments.en: There was a short period a couple of years ago when there were many, many zombie movies.
segments.zh: 几年前，有很多很多僵尸电影。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: For example, Resident Evil or Shaun of the Dead.
segments.zh: 例如，生化危机或死者肖恩。

segments.en: Yeah, yeah.
segments.zh: 对，对。

segments.en: But I wonder in the future if we're going to be seeing movies about other things.
segments.zh: 但我想知道未来我们是否会看关于其他事情的电影。

segments.en: Yeah, I imagine maybe not in these creatures. I don't know. I guess vampires have always been kind of sexy because as you know, they're immortal and...
segments.zh: 是的，我想也许不在这些生物中。 我不知道。 我猜吸血鬼一直很性感，因为如你所知，它们是不朽的，而且......

segments.en: They're good looking.
segments.zh: 他们很好看。

segments.en: They're usually very good looking and charming and that's how they get their victims.
segments.zh: 他们通常非常好看和迷人，这就是他们吸引受害者的方式。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: But it's interesting to see.
segments.zh: 但它很有趣。

segments.en: Let us know.
segments.zh: 告诉我们吧。

segments.en: We're really curious if there are any local fads in your country because sometimes fads can be regional.
segments.zh: 我们真的很好奇您的国家是否有任何本地时尚，因为有时时尚可能是区域性的。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So let us know what you're into.
segments.zh: 所以让我们知道你喜欢什么。

segments.en: Say, I'm into this.
segments.zh: 说，我喜欢这个。

segments.en: Our website is EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 我们的网站是 EnglishPod.com。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: We'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 到时候在那里见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
